title: Trader Diary: BTC at $86,026 & My 5x Leverage Day
content:
🚀 86k on the chart → I whisper “just one more contract”.
💸 Leverage hits 5x, heart rate hits 120.
📉 Price dips 0.5% → I’m suddenly a financial therapist for my own panic.
lesson: If the trade feels like a roller‑coaster, tighten the stop before the loop‑de‑loop.
question: Who else turned a 5‑minute “quick scalpe” into a 2‑hour therapy session? Drop your war stories 👇
